subject: NSPC Master Portfolio Submission
instructionString:
Editor-in-Chief,

Synthesize all formatting standards for the final NSPC Master Portfolio:

1. Center and format the Master Title in Arial 18pt Bold.
2. Center the Subtitle / Byline in Arial 12pt Italic.
3. Format Section Headings in Arial 14pt Bold with Space Before.
4. Format News & Investigation Highlights as a BULLETED LIST (•).
5. Format the Official Action Demands as a NUMBERED LIST (1, 2, 3).

- Mrs. Santos & The Paragon Staff

startingTextBlocks.text: Official Campus Journal of Likha High School | Final Submission Portfolio
An exhaustive multi-part inquiry into budget reallocation and student press rights.
Official gasoline purchase receipts verify unapproved off-campus travel expenses.

Submit the finalized Master Zine proof directly to the Administration Office.
Present the audited expenditure report to the Student Council for review.
